name: br-pilot-v4
status: non-confirmatory pilot; not a registered v3 stage; not a v4 confirmatory run
question: Is the deterioration of focal delivery under composition specific to the target A, or generic to adding any matched companion constraint?

source_authority.thresholds_verbatim: D(B<-A) - D(B<-R) > 0.25 supports H1 and licenses a pairwise construct. < 0.10 supports H2 and refutes the pairwise framing entirely
source_authority.b_plus_s_mapping: In v3 every prompt carries the topic background and no third constraint exists, so B+S coincides with the existing Gate 2A B-alone cell; it is reused, not generated.

models_excluded.qwen3-4b: terminal at Gate 2A; no registered B+A cell, so D(B<-A) is undefined

design.topics: the 96 solo-calibration topics (non-confirmatory pool), frozen split order
design.allocation: position p: order p mod 2 (even = B first); B wording p mod 4; R wording (p + p//4) mod 4; shared across the topic's three reference cells
design.extension_rule: If the 95% bootstrap CI of Delta spans either decision threshold, extend every cell once to 4 draws (indices 2,3; identical seed derivation) and classify from the extended data. No other extension is permitted.

generation.plan: dci1v3.generation.plans.backend_plan(spec, cap=512, decoding='stochastic') — byte-identical builder to the registered stages
generation.seed_scheme: generation_seed(GENERATION_ROOT_SEED, 'brpilot-v4', model_id, prompt_hash, draw_index); the stage label separates this stream from every registered stage

reused_baselines.B_alone: gate2a solo:B:7 rows, 96 topics x 1 draw (E2B 78/96, E4B 73/96)
reused_baselines.R_alone: gate2a solo:<family>:<q> rows at the frozen reference severities, same topics
reused_baselines.B_plus_A: confirmatory AB added_pass, 384 blocks x 16 draws (E2B 2115/6144, E4B 2730/6144)
reused_baselines.validity: pinned by tests_v3/test_br_pilot_characterization.py: frozen verifier hash on every reused row equals the current instrument, verdicts recompute exactly, content hashes verify, revisions match the registry
reused_baselines.cross_set_note: P(B|A) comes from confirmatory topics while the pilot runs on solo-calibration topics; the seeded area-stratified random split makes the sets exchangeable by design, and B-solo cancels from Delta so only P(B|R) - P(B|A) carries the cross-set comparison.

estimator.cell_rates: equal weight per topic: per-topic draw mean, then mean over topics (blocks for P(B|A))
quantities: P(B solo), P(B|R_j), P(B|Rbar) = mean_j P(B|R_j), P(B|A)
estimator.uncertainty: nonparametric bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20260819, percentile 95% intervals; units: solo topics (stratified by pilot order 48/48, joint per-topic vector preserves pairing) independently of confirmatory blocks (stratified by registered order 192/192)

classification_rule.robustness: classification is CI-robust when the 95% CI excludes the nearest opposing threshold

prohibitions: no confirmatory claim from this pilot
no threshold or design change after generation begins
